facts.text: A proof of concept shows that something can work at all; a pilot tests feasibility on a small but real slice; a minimum viable product (MVP) is the smallest deliverable that is still useful.
facts.quote: A proof of concept shows that something can work at all, a pilot tests whether the approach is feasible on a small but real slice, and a minimum viable product (MVP) is the smallest deliverable that is still useful.

facts.text: The booklet borrows from health-research literature the rule that pilots test feasibility, not effectiveness; transferring that rule to engineering is an analogy, not proof.
facts.quote: From the health-research literature it borrows the rule that pilots test feasibility, not effectiveness, and that progression criteria (go, restricted go, pivot, stop) must be declared before results are known; the transfer to engineering is an analogy, not proof

facts.text: Pilot progression criteria—go, restricted go, pivot, or stop—must be declared before results are known.
facts.quote: progression criteria (go, restricted go, pivot, stop) must be declared before results are known

facts.text: The recommended engineering pilot is a deliberately difficult thin vertical slice covering one safety function, one or two machine variants, normal, boundary, degraded and known-difficult cases, the whole tool chain end to end, physical or bench comparators, and pre-declared criteria.
facts.quote: one safety function, one or two machine variants, normal cases plus boundary, degraded and known-difficult cases such as an occluded person in low visibility, the whole tool chain end to end, physical or bench comparators, and pre-declared criteria.

facts.text: An occluded person in low visibility is a recommended known-difficult case for the engineering pilot.
facts.quote: known-difficult cases such as an occluded person in low visibility

facts.text: The recommended engineering pilot runs in months 3 to 5.
The recommended engineering pilot uses 3 to 5 scenario classes, including at least one edge case.
facts.quote: choose 3 to 5 scenario classes including at least one edge case

facts.text: The recommended engineering pilot pre-specifies 10 to 30 physical test points.
The recommended engineering pilot simulates blind before physical results are seen and compares predictions against pre-registered metrics such as detection-range error and stopping-distance error.
facts.quote: simulate blind before the physical results are seen; compare against pre-registered metrics such as detection-range error and stopping-distance error

facts.text: The recommended engineering pilot reports results as a traffic light showing the trusted envelope and failures.
facts.quote: report as a traffic light showing the trusted envelope and the failures

facts.text: A polished animation of one nominal cycle has almost no evidentiary value for the engineering pilot.
facts.quote: A polished animation of one nominal cycle has almost no evidentiary value

facts.text: A pilot charter fixes the decision the pilot informs, uncertainty removed, scope, comparator, challenge cases, metrics, progression criteria, deliverables, and claim limit specifying what the pilot does not establish.
facts.quote: A pilot charter fixes the decision it informs, the uncertainty it removes, scope, comparator, challenge cases, metrics, progression criteria, deliverables and the claim limit, exactly what the pilot does not establish

facts.text: Chapter 13 describes the difficult end-to-end pilot slice as a single “golden thread” credibility slice.
facts.quote: Chapter 13 calls the same idea a single "golden thread" credibility slice.

facts.text: The minimum viable product appears as the “minimum viable deliverable” at the bottom of the booklet's descoping ladder.
facts.quote: The MVP appears as the "minimum viable deliverable" at the bottom of the descoping ladder

facts.text: A 2025 report by the United States Government Accountability Office (GAO), cited by the booklet, recommends iterative minimum viable products for newer programs.
facts.quote: a 2025 report by the United States Government Accountability Office (GAO) recommending iterative minimum viable products for newer programs

facts.text: Engineering counterparts to the pilot concept include the “walking skeleton,” a crude end-to-end chain, and blind prediction.
facts.quote: The engineering cousins are the "walking skeleton", a crude end-to-end chain, and blind prediction

facts.text: In the Sandia Fracture Challenges, expert blind predictions often diverged from experiment.
facts.quote: blind prediction, as in the Sandia Fracture Challenges where expert predictions often diverged from experiment

facts.text: A credible pilot conclusion specifies the regimes and configuration where discrepancies stayed within tolerance, identifies the criterion and condition where simulation failed, and retains physical confirmation for that failure; this is stronger than simply declaring a proof of concept successful.
facts.quote: within these regimes, on configuration A, discrepancy stayed within tolerance for X and Y; the simulation failed criterion Z in condition Q, which keeps physical confirmation
